title: Hornsdale Power Reserve: Victoria and South Australia Separation Event: Final Report
summary: AEMO's final report refined the account of Hornsdale's frequency-control response and documented setting adjustments. Phase 56E entity use: Event response and installed capacity remain distinct from offered service capability, compliance, availability, and value.
key_findings: The asset delivered more fast lower service but less slow and delayed lower service than enabled because of settings.
Entity layer: Hornsdale grid-scale battery in South Australia.
Compatibility boundary: Stable asset identity; event response, compliance intervals, and installed capacity are not one performance series.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: Service-specific response cannot be collapsed into a single availability or value score.
Independent system operator, regulator, court, and state records.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
